vo.previous_text: Daily Max Amount is the most water Spatial Adjust will ask for in one day, in your own units, up to a hard ceiling of 15.
vo.next_text: Lynx Reference Amount is the amount of water a station applies at 100 percent adjust. The suggested percentage is the applied amount divided by this reference.

vo.text: Lynx Reference Amount is the amount of water a station applies at 100 percent adjust. The suggested percentage is the applied amount divided by this reference.
vo.previous_text: Every station whose deficit exceeds this lands on the same suggested percentage, which is why identical numbers appear in runs.
vo.next_text: Set it too low and every suggestion looks enormous: a 10 mm cap against a 3 mm reference gives a maximum suggestion of 333 percent. In Lynx, Next Amount must equal this reference, in the same units.

vo.next_text: Crop Coefficient is a whole-number percentage from 0 to 200, applied to the day's ET before it enters the calculation.

vo.next_text: Below 100, the course is treated as using less water than reference ET suggests; above 100, more. Under Option 1 the dialog greys it out, along with Daily Max Amount and Lynx Reference Amount.
